birth_time_approximate_fields_may_vary_w: The birth time is approximate; the fields below can change within that window.
birth_time_unknown_time_dependent_fields: The birth time is unknown, so lagna, houses, dasha and Ishtakaal are not given.
date_precedes_gregorian_adoption_confirm: This date precedes Gregorian adoption; confirm which calendar the record uses.
nautical_fixed_offset_zone_unsuitable_fo: The zone resolved for this place is a fixed offset, which is unsuitable for a birth record.
polar_latitude_sunrise_may_be_undefined: Polar latitude; the Sun does not rise on some dates, so tithi and Ishtakaal are undefined.
pre_1955_indian_clock_time_ambiguous: Indian clock time before 1955 is ambiguous - Bombay Time, local mean time and IST differed. Set time_standard if you know which the record uses.
